classification.difficultyReason: Combine rectangle and composite areas, apply different percentages to two regions, and express their combined result as a percentage of the whole.

spec.description: Rectangle ABCD with a shaded upper-right square XBYZ. All seven vertex labels and all five printed measurements are retained. Ordinary outlines and labels use black; the meaningful source blue shading uses the house light blue.
spec.mathematics: AB=DC=16 cm, AD=8 cm, AX=12 cm, XB=BY=4 cm. XZ is vertical and ZY is horizontal. The shaded square occupies the upper-right corner; AXZYCD is the unshaded complementary region.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied geometry, measurements and shading are visible.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Find the area of the shaded region $XBYZ$.

children.label: ii
children.prompt: Find the area of the unshaded region $AXZYCD$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find $20\%$ of the area of rectangle $ABCD$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find $80\%$ of the shaded area $+$ $20\%$ of the area of $AXZYCD$.

answer.short:
$35.2\text{ cm}^2$

Find each percentage of its own region, then add.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Express the answer to part c as a percentage of the area of rectangle $ABCD$.

answer.short:
$27.5\%$

Divide the area from part c by the whole rectangle's area and multiply by $100\%$.
